title: Data Integrity Health
objective: Memeriksa stable IDs, links, indexes, aliases, timelines, checksums, dan no-silent-loss reports.
decision_rule: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim kesehatan; cakupan enam sinyal belum lengkap atau observasi tanpa catatan = FAIL; broken_links failed sementara repair_success failed = FAIL broken_links_unrepaired; orphan_records failed sementara repair_success failed = FAIL orphan_records_unrepaired; index_mismatch failed sementara repair_success failed = FAIL index_mismatch_unrepaired; checksum_failure failed sementara repair_success failed = FAIL checksum_unrepaired; silent_loss_report failed sementara repair_success failed = FAIL silent_loss_unrepaired; kegagalan yang terdeteksi dan pulih jujur (repair_success recovered/ok tanpa pelanggaran) = PASS konsistensi; cakupan lengkap tanpa invalidasi atau pelanggaran = PASS.
limitations: Sinyal dinilai dari observasi lokal/definisi kontrak; scan integritas data produksi live belum diamati.
Fault test destruktif atas data pengguna, repair end-to-end pada data nyata, verifikasi perangkat keras, dan publikasi distribusi tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
